CMD [ \"node\", \"server.js\" ]
" file-write
"docker build -t doom-fps-image ./doom-fps" shell
dup "stdout" get print
"stderr" get print
"code" get 0 eq
[
    "Docker image built successfully. Continuing with verification." print
    "docker run -d -p 3000:3000 --name doom-fps-container doom-fps-image" shell
    dup "stdout" get print
    "stderr" get print
    "code" get 0 eq
    [ "Container started. Waiting for server to be ready..." print
      5000 sleep # Give server time to start
      "http://localhost:3000" "curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' %{0}" concat shell # Check http code without output
      dup "stdout" get "200" eq
      [
        "Server is responsive. Verifying game.js" print
        "http://localhost:3000/game.js" "curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' %{0}" concat shell
        dup "stdout" get "200" eq
        [
          "game.js served successfully. All Docker verification steps passed." print
          "docker stop doom-fps-container" shell drop
          "docker rm doom-fps-container" shell drop
          "All files created, containerized, and verified." done
        ]
        [
          "http://localhost:3000/game.js" shell dup "stdout" get print drop # print output of game.js curl for debugging
          "Error: game.js not served correctly." print
          "docker stop doom-fps-container" shell drop
          "docker rm doom-fps-container" shell drop
          "Docker verification failed: game.js not served." done
        ]
        if
      ]
      [
        "http://localhost:3000" shell dup "stdout" get print drop # print output of root curl for debugging
        "Error: Server not responsive after starting container." print
        "docker stop doom-fps-container" shell drop
        "docker rm doom-fps-container" shell drop
        "Docker verification failed: Server not running or not responsive." done
      ]
      if
    ]
    [
      "Error: Docker container failed to start." print
      "Docker verification failed: Container failed to start." done
    ]
    if
]
[
    "Error: Docker image failed to build." print
    "Docker verification failed: Image build failed." done
]
if
